sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensives and Energy dominate broad-trend strength, but short-term slippage in Consumer Defensive signals early rotation while Communication Services remains completely broken.

Healthcare and Energy are the market's clear pillars of sustained strength, holding top-3 positions across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons while maintaining all-green profiles. Technology holds rank 2 on a YTD basis with a 0.533 momentum score, but broader market leadership remains concentrated in these defensive and commodity-oriented groups.

Meanwhile, lower-tier sectors are seeing minor churn: Consumer Cyclical, Real Estate, and Healthcare each nudged up +1 spot over the last 5 sessions, while Financials and Communication Services continue to drift lower. Communication Services sits anchored at the absolute bottom with a momentum score of 0.000.

## Strength
- **All-Green Breadth:** Only 3 of 11 sectors are all-green across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD: Healthcare (0.900 momentum), Energy (0.883 momentum), and Consumer Defensive (0.750 momentum).
- **Sustained Leadership:** Healthcare and Energy are the only sectors maintaining sustained top-3 rank status across 1-, 3-, and 6-month timeframes.
- **Top YTD Ranks:** Energy retains the #1 YTD rank, followed by Technology at #2, Healthcare at #3, and Consumer Defensive at #4.

## Movers & Momentum
- **5-Day Gainers:** Consumer Cyclical (rank 10, 0.367 momentum), Healthcare (rank 3, 0.900 momentum), and Real Estate (rank 7, 0.450 momentum) each improved by +1 spot over the past 5 sessions.
- **5-Day Decliners:** Communication Services (-1 spot to rank 11), Consumer Defensive (-1 spot to rank 4), and Financials (-1 spot to rank 8) saw the sharpest 5-day rank deteriorations.
- **Momentum Laggards:** Communication Services has deteriorated entirely with a 0.000 momentum score at rank 11, trailed closely by Industrials (0.317 momentum, rank 6) and Consumer Cyclical (0.367 momentum, rank 10).

## Divergences
- **Fading Strength:** Consumer Defensive flashes an early warning divergence, maintaining high overall momentum at 0.750 but slipping -1 spot in rank over the last 5 sessions.

- OUT: Financial -> IN: Healthcare - capital shifts away from lagging financials (regime=-0.18, -1 spot) into advancing healthcare leadership (+1 spot, wk=+3.3%, mo=+9.7%, rs_slope=+0.525).
sectors.watchlist:

- Real Estate - Monitor the fresh RS cross trigger marking an early rotation vs SPY; confirmed if relative strength holds above the cross threshold on expanding volume, invalidated by an immediate reversal back into negative relative strength.
- Basic Materials - Track the RS new high trigger with relative strength hitting a 20-session peak; confirmed by continued leadership and price expansion, invalidated if RS fails to hold the breakout level and falls back into its prior 20-day range.
- Consumer Cyclical - Watch the RS new high trigger as relative strength notches a fresh 20-session high; confirmed by relative outperformance sustaining above recent swing highs, invalidated by a quick rejection back below the 20-session high threshold.
- Consumer Defensive - Observe the RS new high trigger indicating leadership via a 20-session relative strength peak; confirmed by follow-through outperformance against the broader market, invalidated by relative strength retreating below the prior breakout high.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive posture and traditional energy dominate broad momentum, while software, internet, and select utilities experience sharp short-term rank deteriorations.

Market breadth remains selective, with 27 of 144 groups maintaining all-green profiles across all tracked time horizons (week, month, quarter, half, YTD). Leadership is anchored by Drug Manufacturers - General (0.928 momentum) and energy sub-industries such as Oil & Gas Drilling (0.878 momentum) and Oil & Gas E&P (0.847 momentum). Meanwhile, high-duration areas are deeply depressed, with Advertising Agencies (0.023) and Solar (0.093) anchored at the bottom of the momentum spectrum.

Rotational dynamics show an influx into industrial and cyclical pockets, led by Engineering & Construction advancing 23 rank spots despite a subdued 0.37 momentum score. Conversely, technology and communications are fading rapidly: Internet Content & Information collapsed 30 spots over the last five sessions to rank 120 (0.100 momentum), alongside sharp drops in Software - Application (-18 spots to rank 117) and Utilities - Regulated Water (-35 spots to rank 74).

## Strength
- **All-Green Breadth:** 27 of 144 industry groups are positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD frames, led by Drug Manufacturers - General (0.93 momentum), Tobacco (0.87), REIT - Hotel & Motel (0.86), and Oil & Gas E&P (0.85).
- **Sustained Leadership:** Top-36 rank consistency over 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons is concentrated in Drug Manufacturers - General, Tobacco, Oil & Gas Integrated, Lodging, Health Information Services, Credit Services, Household & Personal Products, and Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries.
- **Top Momentum Anchors:** Drug Manufacturers - General (0.928 momentum, rank 24 YTD) and Oil & Gas Drilling (0.878 momentum, rank 4 YTD) lead all industries.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top Short-Term Gainers:** Engineering & Construction jumped 23 spots to rank 59 (0.37 momentum), followed by Restaurants (+16 spots to rank 92, 0.53 momentum) and Textile Manufacturing (+16 spots to rank 22, 0.70 momentum).
- **Steepest Five-Day Declines:** Utilities - Regulated Water dropped 35 spots to rank 74 (0.42 momentum), Internet Content & Information sank 30 spots to rank 120 (0.10 momentum), and Education & Training Services shed 28 spots to rank 115 (0.13 momentum).
- **Absolute Laggards:** Advertising Agencies holds the weakest profile in the market (0.023 momentum, rank 144 YTD), followed by Solar (0.093 momentum, rank 141 YTD) and Uranium (0.094 momentum, rank 132 YTD).

## Divergences
- **Fading Momentum:** Healthcare and defensive-growth proxies are slipping in the short term despite strong baseline momentum, including Biotechnology (0.66 momentum, down 12 spots in 5 days), Healthcare Plans (0.63 momentum, down 11 spots), and Waste Management (0.65 momentum, down 11 spots).
- **Emerging Reversals:** Engineering & Construction (+23 spots, 0.37 momentum), Auto & Truck Dealerships (+13 spots, 0.48 momentum), and Luxury Goods (+13 spots, 0.39 momentum) show sharp 5-day rank improvements that outpace their current low-to-mid momentum readings.
- **Fragile Leader:** Marine Shipping maintains an all-green profile but shows structural instability with an agreement score of 0.45.
